lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It runs in four seconds, the way it always does. Allocations against draws, department by department, and at the bottom a single figure that should be zero.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It is not zero. It is the same distance from zero it was last quarter.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Off by a constant. That is the part that is wrong. A rounding drift wanders. A rate change steps once and then stops. A constant means something is being paid on purpose, on a schedule, at a fixed amount.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: It goes back as far as the shell will index and it does not move.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: There is one line the shell cannot allocate to a department. 88-231-C. Quarterly. Outbound.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Outbound. Not a cost, not a transfer, not an internal charge. The Enclave is paying somebody.
